# Tait, 'On Knots. Part II', Trans. Roy. Soc. Edinburgh 32 (1884), §6, pp. 332-334: the partitions
# of 2n "corresponding to each figure in Plate XLIV". Transcribed by Claude from the page images
# (sources/s0080456800026806.pdf, pp. 332-334).
#
# One line per type, in the order of the text:  <order> <type>: <form> <form> ...
# <type> as in plate_xliv.txt. Each <form> is Tait's pair of partitions, upper/lower as printed
# ("or" between the forms of one type dropped). A single partition with a trailing '*' is printed
# with a bar over it: both classes have that partition and the knot is amphicheiral (p. 332).
# Each partition lists the corner counts of the meshes (regions) of one class of the checkerboard
# colouring: Tait's "right and left-handed partitions".
